  content=$(cat "$f" 2>/dev/null | python3 -c "import sys,json; print(json.load(sys.stdin).get('content',''))" 2>/dev/null)
  if echo "$content" | grep -qi "AKIA\|aws_secret\|AWS_SECRET\|wJalr\|Amazon\|S3 bucket\|cloudfront\|access key"; then
    echo "--- FILE: $(basename $f) ---"
    echo "$content" | grep -i "AKIA\|aws_secret\|AWS_SECRET\|wJalr\|Amazon\|S3 bucket\|cloudfront\|access key\|secret" | head -10
    echo ""
  fi
done 2>&1 | head -100
